subject: [PATCH v3 0/4] sunrpc: hardcode pool_mode to pernode, remove other modes

reviews.author: NeilBrown
reviews.summary: The reviewer expressed disagreement with the patch's approach to hardcoding pool_mode to pernode and removing other modes, citing that the problem only occurs when svc_create() is used as when svc_create_pooled() is used, and suggesting a simpler solution where svc_new_thread() checks if the pool is pooled before calling svc_pool_map_get_node().
reviews.raw_body:
I don't think this is the best approach.
The problem only occurs when svc_create() is used as when
svc_create_pooled() is used, svc_pool_map_get() is called early so a
reference is held to svc_pool_map.

svc_new_thread() is the only caller of svc_pool_map_get_node(), and it
can easily check pool->sv_is_pooled and only call
svc_pool_map_get_node() is sv_is_pooled is true.  When false it should
probably use NUMA_NO_NODE.
e.g.

diff --git a/net/sunrpc/svc.c b/net/sunrpc/svc.c
index ae9ec4bf34f7..063826702f46 100644
--- a/net/sunrpc/svc.c
+++ b/net/sunrpc/svc.c
@@ -800,7 +800,10 @@ int svc_new_thread(struct svc_serv *serv, struct svc_pool *pool)
 	int node;
 	int err = 0;
 
-	node = svc_pool_map_get_node(pool->sp_id);
+	if (serv->sv_is_pooled)
+		node = svc_pool_map_get_node(pool->sp_id);
+	else
+		node = NUMA_NO_NODE;
 
 	rqstp = svc_prepare_thread(serv, pool, node);
 	if (!rqstp)


NeilBrown

2026-07-01.patch_summary: This patch series hardcodes the pool_mode to pernode, removing other modes. It addresses a shortcoming in the existing code where RPCs can be scheduled to pools with no threads. The patches also include performance optimizations and improvements to thread auto-placement.
